findings.subject: DefaultLocalThumbnailService#DefaultLocalThumbnailService:Executors.newFixedThreadPool
findings.message: Executors.newFixedThreadPool(...) creates a pool with an unbounded LinkedBlockingQueue.
findings.why: Without a bound, a slow downstream turns into unlimited queued work (memory growth, unbounded latency, lost tasks on restart) or unlimited threads (CPU and memory exhaustion). Nothing pushes back on the caller.
findings.fix: Build a ThreadPoolExecutor (or ThreadPoolTaskExecutor) with a bounded queue, a maximum thread count and a rejection policy.

findings.subject: ProxyFilter#ProxyFilter:WebClient.create
findings.message: WebClient.create(...) uses the default connector: no response timeout (Reactor Netty).
findings.why: A call without a read timeout waits as long as the remote side keeps the socket open. When a dependency hangs, request threads pile up on it until the service stops responding: one slow dependency becomes a full outage.
findings.fix: Use WebClient.builder().clientConnector(new ReactorClientHttpConnector(HttpClient.create().responseTimeout(...).option(ChannelOption.CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MILLIS, ...))), or inject the auto-configured WebClient.Builder.
